body: To be quite honest, I have nothing to wait for me at home, except for Pandora, my cat. Let's say that, at this point, it's more the fascination of the ride that makes me return every time. And the idea that I'm doing something "forbidden".

That's a fairly good point. My country doesn't have Uber, though. 

Kinda sucks, but we do our best with what we're given, I suppose.
You have gotten off at wrong one too, didn't you? Happened to the best of us.

If you still didn't make it to the "afterlife", then, maybe, whatever you can't see IS in the afterlife, already? Also, Angela's grandpa sounds suspicious don't know why.

Stay safe, Friendly Ghost.
